mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (current level below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that elevates discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3%) and low policy rates (FEDFUNDS < 2%) signal delayed monetary accommodation, boosting equity valuations through anticipated future rate cuts and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4%), tight labor markets drive corporate earnings growth through sustained consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 600,000 units signals robust consumer demand for residential construction, accelerating economic growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates strong manufacturing output and economic momentum, supporting corporate profitability and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5-day SPX returns is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high housing starts (HOUST > 600.0) and elevated residential sales (RSAFS > 350,000) signal strong consumer demand for housing, accelerating economic activity and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 600.0 and RSAFS > 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates economic distress and reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.
